name: Flutter SDK
description: Installs the Flutter SDK with Dart for cross-platform development. Supports stable, beta, master channels and specific versions.

version.description: Flutter channel (stable, beta, master) or specific version (e.g. 3.27.4)

precacheWeb.description: Run 'flutter precache --web' after install (faster first web build)

precacheLinux.description: Run 'flutter precache --linux' after install (faster first Linux desktop build)

precacheAndroid.description: Run 'flutter precache --android' after install. Requires Android SDK installed separately.
